Initial release of the waitlister skill:

- Enables creation and management of product-launch waitlists via waitlister.me API.
- Instantly create and publish hosted landing pages with dark/light themes and optional AI-generated design.
- Collect email signups with a built-in referral program for viral growth.
- View waitlist statistics and manage page content (copy, theme, SEO).
- Requires a WAITLISTER_API_KEY for authentication (works on free plan).
